status: conditionally_approved_protocol; thresholds revised to executable rules; training NOT released

primary.name: necessary_step_recall
primary.aggregation: task-level equal weight; report task-group mean; bootstrap over task groups
primary.match_level: semantic primary; operator-level strict auxiliary; frozen mapping table

harmful_extra_step_rate.comparator: A for B-A; B for C-B

long_chain_degradation.subset_rule: top quartile of evaluation reference step counts AND >=20 steps; list frozen with split manifest
long_chain_degradation.rule: NSR drop >3.0pp OR DRC drop >3.0pp vs comparator -> FAIL

parse_health.rule: each field worse >5.0pp -> FAIL; report separately

anomalies.rule: each rate increase >5.0pp -> FAIL with samples

demonstrated: delta_NSR >= +5.0pp point estimate AND task-group bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0
TCC and DRC drop <=3.0pp vs comparator
decision_rule.otherwise: not_demonstrated; report actual values, CI and triggered gates
decision_rule.note: +5pp is a practical improvement target, not a significance substitute; no post-hoc caliber selection

split.limitation: preliminary evidence only; report unit/task-group/task distribution; do not inflate n by steps; do not split frozen components to enlarge test

multiref_discipline: multiref_of all empty; do not relax admission for metrics; eligibility reported only

release_checklist.item: A/B/C definitions and attribution boundaries frozen
audit of 25 split units vs full training corpus task-group mapping
test independence + small-test evidence limitation declared
training config and evaluator scripts frozen
